routes.name: Jordan Visit Visa (single entry)
routes.summary: Many nationalities can get a single-entry visa on arrival at Queen Alia Airport and Sheikh Hussein Bridge. Aqaba Airport needs no visa for non-restricted nationalities. Restricted nationalities need a visa from a Jordanian embassy first.

other: Some nationalities need prior approval. The official list was not readable, so check the Ministry of Interior before you go.
Arab nationalities are not eligible for Jordan Pass.

routes.name: Jordan Pass visa fee waiver
routes.summary: Buy Jordan Pass before you arrive and the single-entry visa fee is waived if you stay at least 2 consecutive nights. Immigration checks when you leave. If you stay less, you pay the fee.

other: Pass price not confirmed on the page read.

routes.name: Visa fee exemption for some nationalities
routes.summary: Per Jordan Pass, South Africa, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Japan, and Vatican City are exempt from visa fees. The official exemption list was not fully confirmed.

routes.name: Transit visa
routes.summary: The Ministry of Interior lists an electronic transit visa. Rules and fees were not readable.

other: Details not confirmed from an official page.

routes.name: Study visa and study residency
routes.summary: The Ministry of Interior offers a study visa and study residency through its e-services.

routes.name: Work visa
routes.summary: The Ministry of Interior lists a work visa. Requirements were not readable on the page.

routes.name: Family residency (joining a spouse)
routes.summary: Annual residency for family members, including joining a spouse, is listed by the Ministry of Interior.

routes.name: Annual residency by bank deposit
routes.summary: The Ministry of Interior lists annual residency based on a bank deposit. Amount not confirmed.

other: Deposit amount and conditions not confirmed.

routes.name: Residency through investment
routes.summary: The Ministry of Interior links a residency-through-investment route. Thresholds were not readable.
